blocks.text: The Marketing and Opinion Research Society of the Philippines (MORES) brought together industry leaders, researchers and academics at MORES Congress 2026 to explore the evolving role of market research in an era of artificial intelligence, economic uncertainty and shifting consumer realities. Held on October 26–27, 2026, at SMX SM Aura in Taguig, the Congress carried the theme “Future in Motion: Insight to Impact.” The first day, themed “Intelligence in Motion,” examined the forces reshaping the Philippine research landscape, highlighting the growing importance of reliable data, deeper consumer understanding and informed decision-making in an increasingly complex world.
